description: Releases from the app and the backend, newest first: crash-free sessions, users and adoption for the app, crash-free and error-free requests for the backend. Use it to tell whether a release made things worse. crashed_sessions counts crashes and bad exits; abnormal_sessions is the bad exits (no crash report, an AbnormalExit issue). `release` (version+build) is the name every tool takes.
name: list_releases
title: List releases and their health
